verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated egress-control feature. Outbound sandbox traffic is routed through Blaxel's proxy with per-domain firewalls, and explicit allowlists and denylists restrict which domains, HTTP methods and URL paths a sandbox can reach. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the egress policy is enforced; detail on non-HTTP/raw-TCP egress control and on policy management at org scale (only short doc summaries are in evidence).
